paths_reviewed.review_notes: The only behavioral call-site change in the inspected diff delegates export rendering to the previously reviewed pure renderer; nextRunAt was extracted to the previously reviewed UTC helper, and DatabaseReportRepository is re-exported from the package surface. The ReportsService persistence/service methods otherwise remain in this file. Existing reports tests cover the service with in-memory repositories; no DB behavior was run in this review.

The DatabaseReportRepository class and its SQL parameter/row-mapping helpers match the corresponding origin/main index.ts extraction exactly. All 15 repository calls use withTenantQuery(getPool()); reads and claim/update queries are account-scoped, claims use SKIP LOCKED and check claim token/lease before fenced writes. Migrations 0134 add composite account foreign keys and 0163 FORCE RLS. These are static observations, not executed SQL proof.

previously_reviewed_path_ref.scope: The test constructs the lazy adapter and checks method presence/schedule cadence; it does not execute SQL.

extraction_comparisons.region: SQL parameter/row-mapping helpers from dateIso through v8 ignore stop

static_boundary_review.tenant_transaction: All 15 methods using SQL call withTenantQuery(getPool()); withTenantQuery establishes and verifies app.current_account_id within a transaction.
static_boundary_review.tenant_predicates: Read/update/claim SQL inspected carries account_id predicates; tenant row policies also exist in migration 0048.
static_boundary_review.fencing: Schedule/delivery claims use FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. Fenced execution/export/delivery writes require the schedule id, claim token, and unexpired lease in SQL.
static_boundary_review.relational_integrity: Migration 0134 adds composite (account_id,id) keys and cross-table account-scoped foreign keys for exports, schedules, and deliveries; migration 0163 enables FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY.
static_boundary_review.runtime_database_verification: Not executed in this review. Database integration test files exist for report delivery, schedule lease fencing, and scheduled execution/export fencing; they were held because test setup may use the explicit local database.

findings_and_limits: ReportExecutionDetail receives expiresAt generatedAt + 7 days, but the service getters/list/hydration path does not enforce that timestamp; repository findExecutions/findExports returns rows without expiry predicates, and no report execution/export purge path was found in the inspected application/migrations. report_exports has no expires_at column.

No report-specific retention contract was found in the inspected current report docs and artifact-retention policy files. Treat expiration meaning and durable deletion/retention as HOLD-CONTRACT for Product/Security-DPO review; this is not declared a defect without an authoritative policy.
saveSchedule uses ON CONFLICT (id) and relies on forced tenant RLS for tenant isolation on a conflicting global id; runtime role/RLS behavior was not proven by executing PostgreSQL integration tests.

Existing focused package suite passed 40/40 in round 1, but its Vitest global setup performed read-only queries and a transient advisory lock against the explicit local cvg_his_v2 database. That historical result does not exercise SQL methods; no further Vitest or DB-backed test was run.

The new report repository path remains blocked from candidate overlay until the data retention contract, SQL integration results on an approved disposable target, full path review, and independent candidate-bound critique are complete.
